{{Quote|On your left is a view of the Senatorial Chambers, where laws for the entire civilized cosmos are debated.|Coruscant tour guide|audio=SenatorialChambers-TOTJ.flac|<ref name="Tales of the Jedi (audio)">[[Tales of the Jedi (audio drama)|''Tales of the Jedi'' audio drama]]</ref>}}
The '''Senate Building''', also known as the '''Senate Rotunda''', '''Senate Tower''', '''Convocation Center''', or '''Senate Dome''', was the building on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] in the center of the [[Senate District/Legends|Senate District]] which served as the seat of the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] from the end of the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]] until the end of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], also serving as the seat of the [[Imperial Senate/Legends|Imperial Senate]] during the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], with the [[Grand Convocation Chamber]] at its heart. The designers claimed that any weapon capable of destroying the Chamber would also have to be powerful enough to destroy the entire planet, making the facility invulnerable against sabotage or [[Orbital bombardment/Legends|orbital bombardment]].

==History==
===Galactic Republic===
[[File:Senatebuildingpgw.jpg|thumb|left|200px|The Senate Building following the [[Great Galactic War]], circa 3,653 BBY.]]
Erected by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] circa [[3996 BBY]] in the wake of the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]], the Senate Rotunda was built on the remains of the former [[Senate Hall]], which had not been used after the [[Duel in the Senate|duel]] between [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Vodo-Siosk Baas]] and [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Exar Kun/Legends|Exar Kun]]. A large [[Mushroom/Legends|mushroom]]-shaped complex, the new Senate building was one of many prominent sites on the city-planet, ranked as one of the largest tourist sites there. Like the [[Imperial Palace/Legends|Presidential Palace]] and the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]], the Senate Building's unique architecture and distance from taller buildings made it easily distinguished amongst the densely packed [[Skylane/Legends|skylanes]] of the Republic's capital.

As the Republic thrived, more worlds joined the Republic following the [[Mandalorian Wars]] and the [[Jedi Civil War]]. Unbeknownst to the Senate or the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]], the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|hidden Sith Empire]] had already infiltrated the ranks of the Senate and the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] in preparation for their return. When the Sith did return, Coruscant was taken unawares and the Empire [[Sacking of Coruscant|struck]] at the Senate District, blackening the facade of the [[Republic Executive Building/Legends|Republic Executive Building]] and leveling the nearby [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]]. With the security-command center in the Temple crippled, Sith forces swept through the Senate and [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Berooken]] was executed by [[Darth Angral]]. With the Chancellor dead and Coruscant defenseless, the Republic was forced to sign the [[Treaty of Coruscant]] and broker peace with the Empire. With the treaty signed, the Empire immediately withdrew from Coruscant and the rebuilding process begun. Over the course of the next week, an enraged [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] called [[Dar'Nala]] orchestrated a [[Bombing of the Senate Tower|bombing]] at the Senate building, blasting apart the upper levels from the inside and killing targeted senators who backed the treaty with the Sith. The attack was designed to reincite the hatred of the Sith and lead the Republic back into war; the plot was revealed by Dar'Nala's former [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], [[Satele Shan]], and the peace was kept. As Interim Chancellor [[Paran Am-Ris]] took the reigns of the Senate, repairs were made to the Senate Building while funds could not be diverted to the rebuilding of the Jedi Temple.<ref name="JMGD" />

Following the end of the [[Galactic War]] with the Sith Empire, the Republic began to thrive once more; the Jedi Temple began reconstruction and worlds ravaged by the Sith were rehabilitated. Peace reigned in the Republic until the devastating [[Battle of Mizra]] between the Republic and a new breed of Sith. The loss drastically weakened the Republic's power during the [[New Sith Wars]] and further decline eventually led to the [[Republic Dark Age]]. In turn, the Jedi began taking up the mantle of [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]], an unprecedented move by the Order as the Jedi tried to keep the increasingly shrinking Republic intact. After four centuries of Jedi rule, [[Tarsus Valorum/Legends|Tarsus Valorum]] was elected Chancellor. The war was ended and the [[Brotherhood of Darkness/Legends|Brotherhood of Darkness]] routed, and the Senate passed the [[Ruusan Reformations/Legends|Ruusan Reformation]] to bring the Republic back in line.

At the close of the [[Golden Age of the Old Republic|Republic's Golden Age]], the [[Vote of No Confidence/Legends|Vote of No Confidence]] in Chancellor [[Finis Valorum/Legends|Finis Valorum]] was accepted by the Senate and Senator [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] of the [[Chommell sector/Legends|Chommell sector]] became Chancellor. During his term, the [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|Separatist Crisis]] tore the Republic apart; as more worlds broke away, tensions rose. [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Granta Omega]] attacked the Senate during this time, killing several senators with a dangerous [[Zone of Self-Containment|air-borne toxin]] developed by [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] [[Jenna Zan Arbor]].<ref name="Jedi Quest: The Changing of the Guard">''[[Jedi Quest: The Changing of the Guard]]''</ref> Eventually the conflict in the Senate evolved into the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. As thousands of star systems withdrew from the capital and the Jedi Order suffered grievous losses in the war, arguments in the Senate chamber became as heated as the Republic's battlefields. After three years of death and destruction in the name of peace, the mysterious [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]] announced the end of the war and the [[Declaration of a New Order]], the first [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. Disbanding the Jedi Order, Sidious was confronted by the Order's [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]], [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]], in the [[Grand Convocation Chamber]]. Hurling over a dozen [[Repulsorpod/Legends|repulsorpods]] with [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] and damaging countless others during the [[Skirmish in the Senate|confrontation]], the newly christened [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] emerged victorious and Yoda fled into exile.<ref name="ROTS" />

===Galactic Empire===
[[File:Rotj_senate.png|thumb|right|250px|The Senate Building glimpsed in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]].]]
{{Quote|How abominable! One would think those Rebels might think innocent lives had some value, but it seems they shall never stop until they're sitting right back here in the old Senate chambers again.|[[Wendell Wright-Sims]], [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]]|<ref name="An Old Flame in Need...">{{WEGCite|story=An Old Flame in Need...|book=Shadows of the Empire Sourcebook}}</ref>}}
The magnitude of damage in the building's convocation chamber caught the eyes of the Senators. Closing the chamber for repair did not put an end to the spread of rumors that Grand Master Yoda had led an attack on Emperor Palpatine himself, and that the ancient Jedi Master had been killed. After repairs were made, the newly appointed [[Imperial Senate/Legends|Imperial Senate]] began meeting in an advisory fashion, holding what amounted to largely elaborate meetings with the [[Grand Vizier/Legends|Grand Vizier]], who would later report back to the Emperor on the result of the deliberation. The Emperor, whose scars prevented frequent public appearances, would use the views of the Senate to temper his own and then act with finality, leaving no room for debate or prolonged discussion.<ref name="Labyrinth of Evil">''[[Labyrinth of Evil]]''</ref>

In [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], nearly two decades after the rise of the Empire, the Imperial Senate was [[Dissolution of the Imperial Senate/Legends|dissolved]] after [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] of the [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] [[Alderaan sector/Legends|sector]] was revealed as a member of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]]. Declaring that the Senate Building may have been penetrated by the Rebels by the use of spies and defectors, the Emperor shut the doors to the rotunda and barred all from entering. While publicly the Empire stated the dissolution was temporary, many senators realized the ends of their careers and quietly slipped out of the public eye as the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] ravaged the Empire.<ref name="Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope">{{Film|IV}}</ref>

===New Republic===
[[File:Bombed_NR_Senate_Hall.jpg|thumb|left|200px|The Senate Hall after the bombing by [[Kueller]].]]
Following the death of the Emperor in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], warring factions within the quickly collapsing Empire waged destruction upon Coruscant. The Senate Building, along with the nearby [[Imperial Palace/Legends|Imperial Palace]], sustained heavy damage but proved resilient never-the-less. As the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] settled into its role as leader of the galaxy, the Senate Building was repaired and the [[New Republic Senate/Legends|New Republic Senate]] convened with its halls. It was within this room that [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] made his plea before the assembly to allow him to reform the [[New Jedi Order|Jedi Order]] and begin searching for new recruits. With a majority backing, Skywalker pledged that the new Order would serve as protectors of the Republic, much as the Jedi had for millennia before the Empire.<ref name="Jedi Search">''[[Jedi Search]]''</ref>

While the structure had proven sound when attacked from the outside in the past, the same could not be said about an internal assault. In [[17 ABY/Legends|17 ABY]] during a full session of the Senate, [[Bombing of the Senate Hall|several detonations]] rocked the tower, hurling rubble onto the Plaza outside and collapsing the [[Chancellor's Podium/Legends|central speaking podium]]. After removing the dead and wounded, it was eventually discovered that the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Kueller]] was responsible for the attack.<ref name="TNB">''[[The New Rebellion]]''</ref> After the issue of the bombing was cleared up, the Senate Hall was gutted and new architects swept into the building and reworked the interior, so much so that many considered it a new complex all together.<ref name="SOTP">''[[Specter of the Past]]''</ref>

While the Republic struggled to establish itself, the galaxy was [[Yuuzhan Vong War|invaded]] by an alien race called the [[Yuuzhan Vong]]. As attacks against Republic worlds increased, Yuuzhan Vong representative [[Nom Anor]] addressed the Senate and encouraged the assembly to denounce the Jedi and hand them over to the invaders. Then [[Chief of State (New Republic)/Legends|Chief of State]] [[Borsk Fey'lya]] rebuffed Anor's plea and had him escorted off Coruscant. However, Anor was successful in increasing the [[Anti-Jedi sentiment/Legends|anti-Jedi sentiment]] among the senators and many Jedi were turned over to the Yuuzhan Vong across the galaxy. As the Senate continued to debate how best to deal with the new threat to the Republic, the Yuuzhan Vong [[Battle of Coruscant (Yuuzhan Vong War)|attacked Coruscant]] in force, breaking through its orbital defenses and smashing through into the skylanes of the city world. As mass evacuations ensued following a crushing victory by the invaders, the Senate Building was left relatively intact if abandoned.<ref name="SBS" />

===Well of the World Brain===
{{Main|Well of the World Brain}}
Following the fall of Coruscant, the Yuuzhan Vong selected the ruins of the Senate Building to serve as the home of their [[World Brain]], a massive [[dhuryam]] which would transform Coruscant into the legendary homeworld of the invaders, [[Yuuzhan'tar (disambiguation)|Yuuzhan'tar]]. Referred to as [[Well of the World Brain|the Well]] by the Yuuzhan Vong, the Senate Building ruins were hollowed out while the exterior was quickly digested by [[yorik coral]] and hardened into an impenetrable substance. Appearing as a rotting skull from the outside, the Well was further protected by a deadly [[hedge maze]] that was planted over the Senate Plaza. Despite the defenses, [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] [[Darth Caedus|Jacen Solo]] and [[Ganner Rhysode]] were able to enter the Well on the pretense that Solo would consult with the World Brain before sacrificing Rhysode to the True Gods. Within the Well, Jedi Rhysode [[Battle of the World-Well|sacrificed]] himself while protecting Solo as he consulted with the World Brain, convincing it to subtly sabotage the Yuuzhan Vong's [[Terraforming/Legends|terraforming]] of the planet.<ref name="Traitor">''[[The New Jedi Order: Traitor]]''</ref>

In an effort to retake Coruscant, members of the Jedi Order planned to destroy the World Brain. As Republic heroes [[Han Solo/Legends|Han]] and [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Solo]] entered the former Atrium with defected Yuuzhan Vong [[Harrar]], a band of [[Shamed Ones]], the lower class of the alien invaders, stormed the building as part of a [[Jeedai heresy|heretical movement]] to overthrow the [[Yuuzhan Vong castes|Yuuzhan Vong caste system]]. Aided by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Masters]] [[Kenth Hamner]], [[Mara Jade Skywalker]], and [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi]] [[Tahiri Veila]], the Jedi and Galactic Alliance fighters were able to convince the World Brain to surrender and, through other events elsewhere on the planet, retake Coruscant for the Galactic Alliance.<ref name="The New Jedi Order: The Unifying Force">''[[The New Jedi Order: The Unifying Force]]''</ref>

===Galactic Alliance===
With the defeat of the Yuuzhan Vong, the New Republic was reorganized into the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] and, after having met on [[Dac/Legends|Dac]] in the Alliance's formative years, the [[Galactic Alliance Senate|Senate]] returned to Coruscant after the [[Swarm War]] and took up occupancy in the restored Senate Building. Having been stripped of all remnants of the Yuuzhan Vong invasion, the complex was reopened and the Senate quickly went into session discussing the second [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] insurrection with vigor. While debate rang out in the Grand Convocation Chamber, protesters from across the galaxy gathered in the Plaza in support of [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]].<ref name="Legacy of the Force: Betrayal">''[[Legacy of the Force: Betrayal]]''</ref>

Over the following months Jedi [[Darth Caedus|Jacen Solo]], [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] of the [[Galactic Alliance Guard]] and the secret [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentice]] of [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lady of the Sith]] [[Lumiya]], quickly amassed power in the Senate, eventually attaining the rank of [[Chief of State (Galactic Alliance)|Chief of State]] alongside [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Cha Niathal]] running a dictatorial campaign and leading the fight in the [[Second Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="LOTJS">''[[Legacy of the Force: Sacrifice]]''</ref> As Colonel Solo's atrocious policies and murderous acts increased, the [[Jedi High Council (New Jedi Order)|Jedi High Council]] was forced to act. Dispatching a team of Jedi to the Senate Building, [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Kyle Katarn]] [[Duel in the Senate Plaza|attempted to end]] Solo's reign. When Katarn was severely injured in the Senate Plaza, the Jedi accompanying him retreated, having installed a tracking beacon in Solo's robes during the chaos.<ref name="Legacy of the Force: Fury">''[[Legacy of the Force: Fury]]''</ref>

==Layout==
===Exterior===
[[File:Senethall.jpg|thumb|left|230px|The Senate Building at night]]
A massive drum-shaped building boasting a shield-shaped dome with a diameter of more than two kilometers, the Senate Building was built some time after [[3996 BBY]] following the [[Duel in the Senate|duel]] between [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Vodo-Siosk Baas]] and [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Exar Kun/Legends|Exar Kun]] in the old [[Senate Hall]]. On Coruscant, new structures were typically erected on top of older buildings, eliminating the need for demolition; the ancient meeting hall of the Galactic Senate served as the foundations of the new Senate Tower.<ref name="IWTPM" />

Located in the heart of the [[Senate District/Legends|Senate District]], the building was situated at the end of a large, flat concourse known as the [[Avenue of the Core Founders/Legends|Avenue of the Core Founders]]. This area was lined with tall, impressionistic humanoid statues, each representing a [[Core Founder/Legends|founder]] from each of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]]. Surrounded by the [[Senate Plaza/Legends|Senate Plaza]], several parks such as the [[Garden of Equality|Gardens of Equality]] and [[Garden of Justice|Justice]] served as meeting places near to the Rotunda.<ref name="TOR">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>

Adorning the front of the building were two narrow towers. One of these structures contained the [[Office of the Supreme Chancellor/Legends|primary office]] of the Supreme Chancellor during the Galactic Republic. The summit chamber's design was antiquate by the administration of Chancellor [[Finis Valorum/Legends|Finis Valorum]] and offered a wide view of the capital. Following the election of Chancellor [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], the former representative of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] ordered the construction of the [[Republic Executive Building/Legends|Republic Executive Building]] and moved his primary working office to a [[Chancellor's Suite/Legends|brand new suite]] there.<ref name="Darth Plagueis novel">[[Darth Plagueis (novel)|''Darth Plagueis'']]</ref>

===Interior===
Entrance to the Rotunda was gained after passing through the ceremonial entryway known as the [[Great Door of the Senate|Great Door]]. Adorned with the [[Galactic Great Seal|Great Seal of the Republic]] and the sigils of the [[Thousand Worlds]], the doors were open to all who might enter, as symbolic of the Republic as the iconography emblazoning the [[Durasteel/Legends|durasteel]]. Directly beyond the Great Door was the large [[Atrium of the Senate]]. This grand, circular chamber was lined with statues of the Republic's greatest heroes and politicians, as well as members of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], the atrium continued on deeper into the building where a long, two-story hall granted access to several first level embassies and conference rooms. Among the room's tower pillars senators and diplomats gathered and conversed with one another before proceeding on into the [[Grand Convocation Chamber]] just beyond the chamber's far door.<ref name="TOR" />

Occupying the majority of the building central mass was the cavernous [[Grand Convocation Chamber]], a tiered chamber sometimes referred to as the Senate Arena. The slightly slopping walls of the funnel-shaped room were lined with [[Repulsorpod/Legends|repulsorpods]] arranged in concentric patterns from floor to ceiling, which soared over a hundred meters high. The center of the vast chamber was dominated by a [[Chancellor's Podium/Legends|podium]] used by the [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]], the [[Vice Chair/Legends|Vice Chair]] and the [[Senior Administrative Aide/Legends|Senior Administrative Aide]] to coordinate the sessions. The chamber contained a total of 1024 repulsorpods, which could be used by delegations from member systems and large voting blocs. When a Senator or representative wished to address the body they were able to detach their pod from its magnetic berth and move out into the open space of the chamber on an automated path. From there, their address would echo throughout the room, translated into hundreds of different languages instantaneously and piped into the other pods for ease of understanding. [[Senate cam droid/Legends|Small hovercams]] constantly hovered around the chamber, recording the words of the speakers and broadcasting them onto the ceiling-mounted [[Viewscreen/Legends|vidscreens]] to allow the congregation to view up close visuals of the orator. Because sessions tended to grow long and last into the night, natural light and air was not used to fill the room. Instead, an artificial glow kept the room lit so as to diminish the senators' sense of time.<ref name="IWTPM" />

[[File:Galacticsenate.png|thumb|right|250px|The [[Grand Convocation Chamber]]]]

Directly beneath the Convocation Chamber was a series of rooms known as the [[Chancellery Secretariat/Legends|Chancellery Secretariat]], a set of offices used by the Chancellor and his aides while at the Senate Building. At the heart of the Secretariat was the [[Chancellor's working office/Legends|holding office]], located directly below the Senate Chamber and home to the Chancellor's podium when it was not in use. Before the start of a session of the Congress, the Chancellor and his aides would board the podium and the ceiling would dilate and the hydraulics driving the chamber would raise it into arena.<ref name="ROTS" /> A [[Turbolift/Legends|turbolift]] was also installed under the Chancellor's seat, able to evacuate him from the podium without having to lower it.<ref name="Cloak of Deception">''[[Cloak of Deception]]''</ref>

Access to the chamber was granted through a small antechamber where the ceremonial, blue-robed [[Senate Guard/Legends|Senate Guard]] stood at attention. The upper tiers of repulsorpods of the Senate Chamber were each assigned a permanent delegation. These senators represented large voting blocs in the Senate or held long tenures in the Republic, such as the representatives of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]]. These delegations were afforded permanent wedge-shaped offices, which included a multi-room preparation chamber adjoined to the delegation's platform and a separate, larger set of chambers which stretched to the outer edge of the building and served as a place for each delegation's countless aides to toil endlessly without need of travel. These offices were separated from each other by the sloping, canyon-like [[Grand Concourse]], a long corridor that ringed the entire Convocation chamber on each level. The black-tile floor of the bridges and walkways that made up the Concourse was punctuated by the towering silver impressionistic statues that lined it, similar to those found on the Avenue of the Core Founders. Private turbolifts lined the walls of the Concourse, conveying senators to and from their offices, connecting them with the rest of the building.<ref name="IWTPM" /> 

In addition to these official chambers, many other governmental offices—both military and bureaucratic—were located throughout the Senate Building. The Jedi Order also maintained a consulate within the tower, reflecting their advisory role in the affairs of the Republic.<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]''</ref>

Security in the building was monitored from the main [[Senate Building security center|security center]] deep in the heart of the building. [[Senate Guard/Legends|Senate Guards]] protected the Senate Chamber as well as delegation offices throughout the building,<ref name="IWTPM" /> while members of the [[Coruscant Security Force/Legends|Coruscant Security Force]] patrolled the halls which were otherwise open to the public.<ref name="TOR" /> Communications throughout the complex were handled by the [[Senate Communications Center]], which was responsible not only for broadcasting the Senate proceedings throughout the building and the galaxy, but for screening all incoming transmissions to Senators and representatives. While each delegation pod in the chamber had privacy buffers under normal circumstances to prevent eavesdropping during private conversations, [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] had this function disabled during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] in an effort to increase security.<ref name="Coruscant and the Core Worlds">''[[Coruscant and the Core Worlds]]''</ref>

Many storefronts and restaurants occupied the Senate Building, allowing Senators and their staff to shop and eat without leaving the complex. The [[Dining commons/Legends|dining commons]] was a formal eating establishment popular during the Clone Wars, while others preferred more casual eateries.<ref name="Senate Spy">{{TCW|Senate Spy}}</ref> Below the Senate Rotunda was the [[Senate Commercial District]], wherein the [[Senate Commercial District|Senate Commerce Hall|Commerce Hall]] and [[Galactic Trade Center]] were located.<ref name="TOR" />

====Remodeling====
Following the [[Declaration of a New Order]], the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Republic Senate]] was reformed into the [[Imperial Senate/Legends|Imperial Senate]], which continued to make use of the Senate Building. Gone were statues of the Jedi Order, as were certain privacy buffers in the Senate pods and offices. Many high level Imperials moved their offices to the [[Imperial Palace/Legends|Imperial Palace]] and the number of planets petitioning for admittance into the Empire paled compared with the Republic. Following the highly-destructive [[Skirmish in the Senate|duel]] between [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] and [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]], the Emperor instructed the architects to install an extensive, crystal ceiling, replacing the old [[Viewscreen/Legends|holomonitors]] and casting a shimmering light on the central podium.<ref name="SOTP" />

The Senate Building stood largely unchanged after the fall of the Empire and the occupation of the Building by the [[New Republic Senate/Legends|New Republic Senate]]. This would change in [[17 ABY/Legends|17 ABY]] when the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Kueller]] [[Bombing of the Senate Hall|bombed]] the structure, collapsing the Chancellor's podium and ripping out chunks of the chamber and killing many members of the Congress. The subsequent reconstruction saw the internal fittings of the auditorium completely replaced and the Grand Convocation Chamber, which reopened in [[19 ABY/Legends|19 ABY]], was thought of by many contemporaries as an entirely "new" structure, distinct from the old Senate Chamber. The facility was extensively redecorated; no longer would the leader of the Senate, now known as the Chief of State, stand at the center of the room, but on a dais at the room's ground level. Most strikingly of all, in place of the former geometric arrangement of repulsorpods, the seating for delegates was organized into clusters of differing size and shape arranged around the rotunda, connected to each other by ramps and stairways, and capable of holding more than 2,000 delegates. The overall effect of the design was to create a complex arrangement of contrasting forms and details, combined nevertheless into a clear, coherent harmony.<ref name="SOTP" />

Despite changes to the main chamber, the old Senate Building's superstructure proved to be an exceptionally durable shell to house the Convocation Chamber without demolition being necessary. The main entrance was still through the venerable Great Door and the Atrium which it enclosed, and while the fittings of the Senate Chamber might have been entirely new, they had been reverently installed in an old auditorium, leaving the preexisting structure intact underneath. Statues around the building were replicated and installed; however, post-Imperial influence saw the addition of non-Human figures all around the complex. As membership in the New Republic grew, new balconies were added to the existing clusters to accommodate the growth; rumors about reincorporating the repulsorpods spread during [[Borsk Fey'lya]]'s administration, but never came to fruition under the New Republic.<ref name="Traitor" />

Following the [[Battle of Coruscant (Yuuzhan Vong War)|Battle]] of Coruscant during the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] [[Yuuzhan Vong War|invasion]], both the exterior and interior of the building were digested by [[yorik coral]], giving the building the appearance of a Yuuzhan Vong skull. The new indemonstrable shell of the Senate Building delved deep below the tower, encasing the structure and making it sound against [[Concussion missile/Legends|concussion missiles]] and orbital bombardment&mdash;possibly even a planetary explosion. Inside, the former Senate auditorium was filled with a pool of nutrients and became the home of the giant [[World Brain]], the controlling organ behind the invaders [[Terraforming/Legends|terraforming]] project. Still accessible from the former Atrium of the Senate, a long corridor cut half a kilometer into the building and onto a bridge that spanned half the convocation chamber. The holding office below was transformed into a secret bunker, where a single escape craft was preserved for [[Nom Anor]].<ref name="Traitor" />

[[File:Senate_hallway_concept.jpg|thumb|250px|Concept art by Ryan Church of one of the Senate Building's hallways.]]
Following the defeat of the Yuuzhan Vong, the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] restored the Building to its pre-Imperial form. The [[Chief of State's Suite]] was placed at the summit of the building, and repulsorpods were reincorporated into the Grand Convocation Chamber. The Chief's podium was not recreated however; instead they would occupy their own floating platform to make addresses to the Senate.<ref name="LOTJS" />

==Behind the scenes==
Although the Senate chamber in ''[[The New Jedi Order: Traitor]]'' ([[28 ABY/Legends|28 ABY]]) is clearly intended to be the same space used in the [[Prequel trilogy|prequels]], references in several novels, including ''[[Specter of the Past]]'' (dated [[19 ABY/Legends|19 ABY]]) and ''[[The New Jedi Order: Dark Tide I: Onslaught]]'' ([[26 ABY/Legends|26 ABY]]), suggest that the old Senate building had been irreparably damaged in the attack in ''[[The New Rebellion]]'' ([[17 ABY/Legends|17 ABY]]), and subsequently demolished.

While the earlier authors had obviously intended the new Senate to be a completely new building, it is possible to reconcile the novels by assuming that the new structure was in fact erected within the shell of the old Senate Building.

[[Ryan Church]] was a concept artist who worked on interior concept pieces for the Senate Building for [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'']].
